acceptanceCriteria.text: CI creates or consumes the same production-shaped deployment descriptor representation used by release publication.
The generated descriptor is passed through the real source-resolution contract, not a duplicated parser/validator fixture.
The realized managed-generation identity is checked against the same canonical runtime-contract implementation used in production.
A fixture/substitution reproducing the former npm-tarball-SHA-as-source-NAR defect causes the gate to fail.
A fixture/substitution reproducing the former workflow-specific generation-identity defect causes the gate to fail.
The gate is part of the authoritative release/deployment CI path and cannot silently be skipped on a release-triggering change.
Expensive real KVM certification remains #261; this gate stays deterministic/hermetic enough for normal CI.

issue.title: chore: add a production deployment artifact round-trip gate
